name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Anti-duplication history sliding window, randomized seed query, strictly People category categories=001 for Girls/Models with zero trees, category renamed to Trucks & Jeeps with ultra-precise vehicle tags)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Anti-Duplication History Cache: keeps sliding window of the last 100 wallpaper IDs with random 6-char seed on every search, eliminating duplicates
Girls, Models & Fashion precision: fixed Wallhaven categories=001 (People category) SFW purity=100, eliminating random tree fallbacks
Trucks & Jeeps precision: renamed category from Trucks & 4x4 Off-Road to Trucks & Jeeps (truck, pickup, jeep, lorry, off-road jeep) with 100% vehicle accuracy
Clean top bar layout with dashes, RU/EN/CS order, compact sound button, and widened font column 2
Ultra-low ~1.5-2 MB RAM idle footprint and minimal silent installer
